context: Sho and Hina help their mother around the house.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: しょう、お母さん、役立つ、しよう。
lines.en: Sho, let's help mom — we can do something useful together!
lines.style: Bright, eager opening. High child's voice carries genuine conviction without performance. Warm throughout, with soft natural cadence. Bounces slightly on the proposal but grounded in real sweetness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.en: Yeah — I'll try really hard. I promise.
lines.style: Quiet, firm commitment from a small voice. No doubt, no hesitation. Soft warmth underneath. The kind of certainty only a child can offer when they mean it completely.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.jp: 一緒に、お手伝い、楽しい。
lines.en: It's going to be fun if we do it together.
lines.style: Bright, inclusive excitement. Emphasizes the togetherness, not the task. Natural child's rhythm, genuine warmth threaded through. Reaches toward him with the invitation.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 優しい、子、ぼくたち、本当。
lines.en: We're kind kids, the both of us. Really.
lines.style: Small voice carries unexpected tenderness and quiet certainty. Thoughtful pause before 'really' — not boasting, just stating something he has noticed and believes. Soft, grounded conviction.

lines.speaker: hina_child
lines.en: Everyone in our family's going to be so happy. I know it.
lines.style: Closing warmth with deep gratitude. Bright but not frantic — speaks from certainty about what this will mean. Soft childish cadence, but the emotion underneath is real and measured.
